definitions.explanation: The degree of detail visible in an image, whether on a screen, in a photograph, or through an optical instrument. Almost always appears in the compound {解像度|かいぞうど} (resolution as a measurable quantity).

examples.japanese: ⟦{解像度|かいぞうど}→解像度：04888_kaizoudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解像度|かいぞうど}→解像度：04888_kaizoudo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧くらいです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is the resolution of this camera?

examples.japanese: ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解像度|かいぞうど}→解像度：04888_kaizoudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧や⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧より⟦{鮮明|せんめい}→鮮明：14686_senmei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}される→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦バッテリー→バッテリー：04425_batterii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{消耗|しょうもう}→消耗：13292_shoumou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Increasing the screen resolution displays text and photos more clearly, but the battery drains faster as a result.

notes:
Composed of {解|かい} (resolve, analyze) and ⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (image). In practice, {解像|かいぞう} almost never appears alone — it is nearly always used in the compound ⟦{解像度|かいぞうど}→解像度：04888_kaizoudo⟧ (resolution, literally "degree of image resolution"). This is an essential technology term for discussing cameras, displays, printers, and digital media.

Note: the homophone ⟦{改造|かいぞう}→改造：00145_kaizou⟧ (remodeling, modification) is a completely different word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{高|こう}{解像度|かいぞうど}→高解像度：26204_koukaizoudo⟧: high resolution
- ⟦{低|てい}→低〜：03961_tei⟧⟦{解像度|かいぞうど}→解像度：04888_kaizoudo⟧: low resolution
- ⟦{解像度|かいぞうど}→解像度：04888_kaizoudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to increase resolution
- ⟦{解像度|かいぞうど}→解像度：04888_kaizoudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: the resolution is low
- {解像力|かいぞうりょく}: resolving power (optics)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{画素|がそ}→画素：05225_gaso⟧: pixel — the individual dots that make up a digital image
- ⟦{画質|がしつ}→画質：16156_gashitsu⟧: image quality — a broader concept than resolution alone
- ⟦{鮮明|せんめい}→鮮明：14686_senmei⟧: clear; sharp — describes the visual result of high resolution
